newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: S.Korean envoy faces probe on sex abuse complaint.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean envoy faces probe on sex abuse complaint.

text.p: Dutch police said on Friday they were investigating a sexual abuse complaint against the South Korean ambassador to the Netherlands, Kyung-Chul Kim.
"We are investigating a charge of sexual abuse brought against the ambassador by his female cook," said Liesbeth Horstink, spokeswoman for the public prosecutor's office.
Horstink said the prosecutor's office would apply to the Dutch Foreign Ministry to waive the ambassador's diplomatic immunity so that he could be interviewed.
"We plan to lodge a request with the ministry in the next few days," Horstink said.
Kim's lawyer, Boycy Teunis, said: "My client is denying everything at this stage."
Teunis would not comment when asked whether the ambassador would agree to be interviewed by police.
"At the moment we are looking into the possibility of reaching an out-of-court settlement," he said.
